The quotation describes a government program offering free courses in engineering and manufacturing — the specific mechanism is subsidized vocational/skills training targeted at particular industrial sectors.

Primary dimension: vocational education and training policy → I2 (Education and Research Institutions)
Secondary dimension: the engineering and manufacturing sector focus adds a labor supply/skills dimension → J2 (Demand and Supply of Labor); and the sectoral focus on manufacturing is substantively present → L6 (Industry Studies: Manufacturing)
